event.label: MEASURED
event.source: DONKI 2024-05-20T05:36:00-CME-001: EUV wave seen by SDO at 05:22Z, fast halo CME at 05:36Z; source on the Sun's far side

cme.note: Fast halo CME visible in SOHO LASCO C2/C3 and STEREO A COR2. The source is believed to be backsided, with moving field lines and EUV wave visible in SDO AIA 171/193 at 2024-05-20T05:22Z. A filament eruption and C6.7 flare peaking at 2024-05-20T05:54Z from Active Region 3683 (approx. S24W65) occurred around the same time, but was determined not be the source of this fast halo CME due to location and timing.

flare.label: DERIVED
flare.source: JPL, June 10, 2024 (https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/nasa-watches-mars-light-up-during-epic-solar-storm/): estimated from Solar Orbiter data; the flare was on the far side of the Sun as seen from Earth

arrival.text: Particles reached Mars in tens of minutes.
arrival.label: MEASURED

rad_dose_uGy.label: MEASURED
rad_dose_uGy.meaning: the dose an astronaut standing next to Curiosity would have received, from Curiosity's RAD instrument (JPL: the biggest surge RAD had measured since landing)

light_time_min.label: DERIVED
light_time_min.source: JPL Horizons, Earth-Mars one-way light time at the onset

alignment.label: PLACEHOLDER
alignment.rule: the event begins at the walking sample nearest the middle of each walk

dose_scaling.label: MODELED
dose_scaling.text: Modeled doses are scaled so that the whole event under an open sky equals RAD's 8,100 micrograys, at a constant dose rate over the PLACEHOLDER event length; real storms rise and fall, and JPL gives no duration.

Faint CME to the east. Its source could be 2024-05-20T18:36Z slow eruption in AR 3688, with dimming enlarging the coronal hole located to the south of this AR. The eruption is likely centered around (S25E35).

Faint CME to the SE (the second, more S in a pair of closely following faint and narrow CMEs). Its source could be the continuing eruption SE of AR 3688 seen after 20Z as dimming seen as enlarging the SE CH to the south of the Active Region. This dimming is centered at S28E33.
